title: How Taiwan's Hsinchu Science Park, home to TSMC, became especially wealthy; one neighborhood reported 2023 average household incomes of $146K+, ~5x the average (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: How Taiwan's Hsinchu Science Park, home to TSMC, became especially wealthy; one neighborhood reported 2023 average household incomes of $146K+, ~5x the average — Fortunes, luxury buildings and birthrates are rising in the city at the center of Taiwan's chip supply chain.
